name: Extended Bone Meal

mechanics.title: Sneak instant growth
mechanics.description: Using bone meal on a crop while holding sneak grows it straight to its mature stage.

mechanics.title: New bone-meal targets
mechanics.description: Bone meal now advances nether wart, cactus, sugar cane and vines.

vanilla_changes.change: Works on nether wart, cactus, sugar cane and vines; sneak-use fully grows crops.

editor_notes: Server-side mod (Modrinth: client unsupported). Exact per-block growth amounts not documented. Pack also has Random Bone Meal Flowers; both change bone meal.
summary: Extends what bone meal can do: it grows nether wart, cacti, sugar cane and vines, and sneaking while using it instantly grows crops to maturity.
